taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station BMGS-bori-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1005 | 3.42 | 3.42
2 | 3588 | 6.33 | 9.76
3 | 1358 | 10.9 | 20.7
4 | 333 | 9.08 | 29.7
5 | 2950 | 36.8 | 66.5
6 | 5469 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as H-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: BMGS-bori-field
Curve type: KQHA (recomputed from the layer resistivities — 1005<3588>1358 (K), 3588>1358>333 (Q), 1358>333<2950 (H), 333<2950<5469 (A); this does not match the "H-type" label on file, so the file classification should be corrected/flagged for QA)
Aquifer depth: 20.7 m to 29.7 m (Layer 4, 333 ohm-m low-resistivity unit sandwiched between higher-resistivity layers — the local H-signature within the sequence)
Recommendation: Plan drilling to penetrate through 29.7 m to fully intersect the conductive Layer 4 target, casing off the overlying 0–20.7 m section (layers 1–3) to prevent cross-contamination and borehole collapse; confirm lithology and water strike with cuttings/geophysical logging across the 20.7–29.7 m interval before finalizing screen placement.
